def find_hollow_rectangles_with_colors(grid):
    """Find hollow rectangles where border has one color and interior has different"""
    results = []
    
    # Get bounding box of all non-zero content
    non_zero_positions = [(r,c) for r in range(len(grid)) for c in range(len(grid[0])) if grid[r][c] != 0]
    if not non_zero_positions:
        return results
    
    min_r, max_r = min(p[0] for p in non_zero_positions), max(p[0] for p in non_zero_positions)
    min_c, max_c = min(p[1] for p in non_zero_positions), max(p[1] for p in non_zero_positions)
    
    # Search within this bounding area
    for height in range(3, 10):  # Consider rectangles 3-9 rows tall
        for width in range(3, 15):  # And 3-14 columns wide
            for top_r in range(min_r, min_r + 10):
                for left_c in range(min_c, min_c + 15):
                    bottom_r = top_r + height - 1
                    right_c = left_c + width - 1
                    
                    if bottom_r > max_r or right_c > max_c:
                        continue
                    
                    # Check if this forms a valid hollow rectangle
                    border_color = None
                    interior_color = None
                    is_valid = True
                    
                    # Check corners are same color
                    corner_color = grid[top_r][left_c]
                    if grid[top_r][right_c] != corner_color or \
                       grid[bottom_r][left_c] != corner_color or \
                       grid[bottom_r][right_c] != corner_color:
                        is_valid = False
                        break
                    
                    # Check top/bottom edges are uniform
                    top_edge_ok = all(grid[top_r][j] == corner_color for j in range(left_c, right_c+1))
                    bottom_edge_ok = all(grid[bottom_r][j] == corner_color for j in range(left_c, right_c+1))
                    left_edge_ok = all(grid[i][left_c] == corner_color for i in range(top_r, bottom_r+1))
                    right_edge_ok = all(grid[i][right_c] == corner_color for i in range(top_r, bottom_r+1))
                    
                    if not (top_edge_ok and bottom_edge_ok and left_edge_ok and right_edge_ok):
                        is_valid = False
                        break
                    
                    if is_valid:
                        # Check interior has different color(s)
                        interior_rows = range(top_r+1, bottom_r)
                        interior_cols = range(left_c+1, right_c)
                        
                        interior_set = set()
                        for i in interior_rows:

# Find all connected components (non-zero cells connected orthogonally)
def find_connected_components(grid):
    rows, cols = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    visited = set()
    components = []
    
    for r in range(rows):
        for c in range(cols):
            if grid[r][c] != 0 and (r,c) not in visited:
                comp = []
                queue = [(r,c)]
                while queue:
                    curr_r, curr_c = queue.pop(0)
                    if (curr_r, curr_c) in visited or grid[curr_r][curr_c] == 0:
                        continue
                    visited.add((curr_r, curr_c))
                    comp.append((curr_r, curr_c, grid[curr_r][curr_c]))
                    
                    for dr, dc in [(-1,0),(1,0),(0,-1),(0,1)]:
                        nr, nc = curr_r + dr, curr_c + dc
                        if 0 <= nr < rows and 0 <= nc < cols:
                            if (nr, nc) not in visited and grid[nr][nc] != 0:
                                queue.append((nr, nc))
                components.append(comp)
    return components

components = find_connected_components(grid)
print(f"Found {len(components)} connected components:")

for i, comp in enumerate(components[:5]):  # Show first 5
